entities.summary: Aziz Abbes Mouhiidine is an Italian boxer. He competed at the 2021 AIBA World Boxing Championships, winning the silver medal in the heavyweight event, and at the 2022 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the gold medal in the heavyweight event.
